dct_title_s: Relationship to Head of Household, Uruguay, 2011
dct_description_sm: This polygon shapefile represents a person's relationship to the.head of household according to the 2011 Census of Uruguay. The census information was collected by the Instituto Nacional de Estadistica in Uruguay between September 1 and December 31 of 2011.The original questionnaire and other supporting documentation for this census is included with this download.
These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production.
